claims.claim: Calibrate measurement and receipt attribution before new effectiveness comparisons.
claims.evidence_or_assumption: Review exceeds generation burden; P08 required attribution repair; uncertain fit differs from explicit constraint relaxation.
claims.arms: Current frozen rubric versus same rubric with source-linked anchors; identical blinded challenge microitems. Anchors cover fit categories, source extensions, family uncertainty, P08 opaque mappings and progress versus terminal receipts; semantic disagreements remain uncertain.
claims.unit: 12 pilot microitems, then 12 fresh holdouts, balanced across factual attribution, fit and retention; include every P01-P10 contract.
claims.metrics: Errors per declared field; abstention/disagreement; exact unit coverage; source-binding failures; reviewer words/calls. Typed ledger: phase, event_kind, unit_id, role_id, handle, turn, source/prompt/output hashes, dependency disposition, terminal witness and repair_of; progress never counts as completion.
claims.failure_rule: Residual attribution/terminal error in the adopted route blocks downstream scoring; no improved semantic agreement permits no calibration-benefit claim. Preserve old audit and separate P08 repair verification.
claims.planned_role_budget: Each phase: four independent reviewers, two per arm, one scalar-only adjudicator, one auditor; 12 roles maximum overall.

claims.claim: Source-bound compression may prevent unsupported extensions without losing complete discriminators.
claims.evidence_or_assumption: Old P09 introduced seven extensions versus zero ordinary; mixed retention, historical/untouched strata distinct.
claims.arms: Ordinary; exact frozen old-P09 prompt; repaired source-bound prompt. All receive identical raw bytes and 350-word ceiling. Repair requires source-ID relation, rival prediction, defeat condition, uncertainty and unchanged fit; new ideas occupy a separately labelled proposal field excluded from preservation credit.
claims.unit: Six fresh pilot cases: two hammer-like design, two analysis-workflow, two service-workflow; one compression per arm per case. Confirm on 12 fresh cases, four per stratum. Historical diagnostics remain development-only.
claims.metrics: Every raw ID's relation/discriminator/uncertainty disposition; unsupported additions per post item and per packet; full retention conjunction; fit errors; lineage and saved burden.
claims.failure_rule: Any unsupported extension fails fidelity for that packet. Advance repair only with zero pilot extensions and no lower complete-retention count than ordinary; confirmation without both conditions rejects benefit, retaining failures.
claims.planned_role_budget: Pilot: 18 compressors, four reviewer shards, one adjudicator, one auditor. Confirmation: 36 compressors, eight shards, one adjudicator, one auditor; total 70 roles.

claims.claim: Alternative visibility is a deterministic presentation outcome, separately testable from invention.
claims.evidence_or_assumption: Historical replacements 39/109; fresh 28 evaluable and 28 gated, zero eligible alternatives.
claims.arms: Ordinary first-two versus alternative second-slot; identical candidate IDs, locked assessments, first slot, eligibility, stable tie-break and fallback within each compression arm.
claims.unit: Every preregistered I09/I02-I08 candidate set, including failed, unresolved and no-opening sets; no eligibility-based sampling.
claims.metrics: Planned/evaluable/gated/eligible denominators; entering/displaced contracts and families; exposure, score displacement, text burden, gate cause.
claims.failure_rule: Any score/first-slot mutation or illegal candidate invalidates comparison. Zero eligibility remains zero opportunity; increased exposure alone earns no decision-value credit.
claims.planned_role_budget: Zero generators or new semantic raters; deterministic comparisons plus one independent auditor per phase.

claims.claim: A visible alternative may improve actual human choices, but could impose review burden.
claims.evidence_or_assumption: Human value untested; participant access absent.
claims.arms: Randomized ordinary versus alternative view with fixed first slot, shared evidence access and equal display budget; participant sees each case once, counterbalanced case order.
claims.unit: Resource-gated pilot: 12 participants × four tasks across six cases; confirmation: 24 new participants × four tasks across 12 fresh cases. Participant is clustering unit; include fallback/no-eligible tasks.
claims.metrics: Choice value under frozen synthetic outcome tables, constraint violations, completion time, confidence/error calibration; table validity and participant availability gates precede execution.
claims.failure_rule: No positive mean value difference, increased violations or median time increase exceeding 20% defeats proposed benefit; intervals may leave result inconclusive. Synthetic task value cannot establish field benefit.
claims.planned_role_budget: Two independent analysis roles and one audit per phase; six support roles, human recruitment separate and uncommitted.

claims.claim: Test generation, compression and exposure as separate factors before claiming pipeline gain.
claims.evidence_or_assumption: Standalone findings provide no composed-effect evidence.
claims.arms: P05 versus ordinary generation × ordinary versus repaired source-bound compression × ordinary versus alternative view; eight cells. Freeze raw assessments before compression; freeze arm-specific retention before ranking. Old-P09 remains I09 comparator.
claims.unit: Four pilot and eight fresh confirmation paired blocks, evenly design/analysis; prospectively select I05/I09 aligned blocks independent of results, otherwise gate reuse.
claims.metrics: Raw qualified/exclusive families, preserved qualification, eligible/exposed families and factor interactions; report unconditional planned-block rates and conditional stage transitions separately.
claims.failure_rule: Summary-only addition cannot earn generation credit; no positive generation contrast means no invention claim. Missing cells gate combined effect; no interaction advantage rejects composition benefit.
claims.planned_role_budget: Reuse exact matched source/review artifacts; two independent stage auditors per phase. Unmatched sources require a separately frozen budget before execution.

claims.claim: All followups retain original success definitions and measurement obligations.
claims.evidence_or_assumption: Track A supplies constructive study detail; this track supplies common measurement.
claims.arms: P01 return-arrow/no-loop; P02 attack/critique; P03 conversion/resistance; P04 hybrid/parents/link-break; P05 backcast/ordinary; P06 carrier/original; P07 protected rivals/ordinary; P08 fixed-report deferred/consensus; P09 three compressors; P10 two views. Preserve I11 inversion/attack/conversion and I12 interface/deferred-convergence factorials.
claims.unit: Every registered case/repetition, including no useful opening.
claims.metrics: Contract, distinction, informative feasibility, fit, retention and visibility separately; physical resources and human outcomes behind explicit gates.
claims.failure_rule: A stopping cap cannot establish informative feasibility; unresolved fit cannot qualify. Never replace failed attempts with successful ones.
claims.planned_role_budget: No extra generation here; common coverage ledger reused by all studies.

selected_unit.responsibility: One paired case block with independently attributable stage dispositions.
selected_unit.level: Study execution contract, below portfolio and above individual proposal.
selected_unit.inputs: Frozen case, constraints, archive, criteria, source hashes, raw IDs, operator and comparator, receipts.
selected_unit.outputs: Raw qualification, retention, exposure, gates, coverage and burden with immutable evidence pointers.
selected_unit.recomposition: Append blocks into stratified I01-I13 comparisons; retain shared-source identity instead of counting reused sources as independent replication.
selected_unit.missing_glue: Review cache key includes source, rubric, archive and context hashes; reuse two independent raw reviews only on exact matches. Every unit still receives dual lineage, family/contrast and post-review rows. Resource inventories, fresh task authoring and participant recruitment remain prerequisites.

priorities: First freeze typed ledger and calibration packet specifications; run no trials during planning.
I01 precedes I09; constructive I02-I08 pilots continue under unchanged criteria.
I10 exposure follows locked assessments; I13 follows aligned generation and retention; human decision evaluation awaits resources.
assumptions: All predecessor hashes verified; historical and fresh strata remain separate.

Three concurrent native helpers maximum; reviewer shards cover at most three case packets or 12 calibration microitems, 2,000 output words each. Coverage precedes soft brevity; actual tokens remain unavailable.
First saves, missing dependencies, nulls, failures and repairs remain append-only; zero scored retries. Fresh confirmation authors avoid pilot text and archives.
Frame expires if supplied resources or success criteria change; re-freeze prospectively, never rescore predecessor results.
rejected_alternative: Compress only successful raw proposals, relax fit to conditional, or present eligible-only rates: these manufacture favorable denominators and confuse invention, preservation and exposure.
